officials.name: Eugenia "Gina" Montoya Ortega
officials.address: 845 N Motel Blvd. Las Cruces, NM 88007
officials.bio: Doña Ana County Assessor Eugenia "Gina" Montoya Ortega, was elected in November 2022, and she took office on Jan. 1, 2023.

officials.name: Amanda Lopez Askin, Ph.D.
officials.address: 845 N Motel Blvd Las Cruces, New Mexico 88007
officials.bio: Amanda López Askin has served as the Doña Ana County Clerk since September 2018, first by appointment and then by election in 2020 and 2024. Her responsibilities include maintaining public records, issuing marriage and business certificates, and administering elections, as well as serving as the Clerk of the Probate Court.

officials.name: Christopher Schaljo Hernandez
officials.address: 845 N Motel Blvd, Las Cruces, NM88007
officials.hours: Third Monday of each month, 11 a.m. - 1 p.m.
officials.bio: Christopher Schaljo-Hernandez was elected to the Doña Ana County Commission District 1 seat in November of 2022, taking office on Jan. 1, 2023. He earned a bachelor’s degree in Government from New Mexico State University in 2012 and has been involved in local and statewide politics. Commissioner Schaljo-Hernandez has served various community nonprofits and is a former chair of The Doña Ana County Democratic Party.

officials.name: Gloria Gameros
officials.address: 845 N Motel Blvd, Las Cruces, NM88007
officials.bio: Gloria Gameros was elected as the District 2 Commissioner in November 2024. Gameros served as a Trustee and Mayor Pro Tem for the City of Anthony, NM, from 2016 to 2021. Her professional background includes small business ownership and finance, having owned a massage therapy practice in Las Cruces for 16 years, worked in payroll and data entry for the Gadsden School District, and held positions in two CPA firms in El Paso. This wide-ranging experience gives Commissioner Gameros a unique perspective on community needs, financial stewardship, and local governance. Committed to improving the quality of life for her constituents, Commissioner Gameros emphasizes open communication and plans to hold regular meetings to address community concerns.

officials.name: Manuel A. Sanchez
officials.address: 845 N Motel Blvd, Las Cruces, NM88007
officials.bio: Manuel Sanchez was appointed to the commission seat in District 5 on March 28, 2019. He served the remainder of the term vacated by Karen Trujillo. Commissioner Sanchez is originally from Anthony, grew up in El Paso, and studied mechanical engineering at MIT, later working for General Electric.

officials.name: Susana Chaparro
officials.address: 845 N Motel Blvd, Las Cruces, NM 88007
officials.bio: Commissioner Susana Chaparro was elected to the District 4 seat on the Doña Ana County Board of Commissioners on Nov. 3, 2020, and assumed duties on Jan. 1, 2021. Her four-year term ends Dec. 31, 2024, and she is eligible to seek re-election. District 4 encompasses most of northeast Doña Ana County, including the East Mesa, Hacienda Acres, Organ, Moongate and the eastern areas of the City of Las Cruces.

officials.name: Susie Kimble
officials.address: 845 N Motel Blvd, Las Cruces, NM 88007
officials.bio: Patricia S. "Susie" Kimble was appointed as the District 3 Commissioner by Governor Michelle Lujan Grisham in February 2026. She is completing the term of former Commissioner Shannon Reynolds, which runs through December 31, 2026. Kimble brings extensive experience in behavioral health policy and community collaboration.

officials.name: Judith Ann Baca
officials.address: 845 N. Motel Blvd., Rm. 1-201 Las Cruces, NM 88007
officials.bio: Doña Ana County Probate Judge Judith Ann Baca was first elected in November 2022. Her term began Jan. 1, 2023 and runs through Dec. 31, 2027. The Doña Ana County Probate Judge decides legal matters related with estates of deceased persons. Probate cases may be opened for decedents with or without a will.

officials.name: Kim Stewart
officials.address: 845 N Motel Blvd Las Cruces, NM 88007

officials.name: Marisol Richardson
officials.address: 845 N Motel Blvd Las Cruces, NM 88007
officials.bio: Doña Ana County Treasurer Marisol Richardson became the Chief Financial Officer for Doña Ana County in 2024 after serving for more than two years as Chief Deputy Treasurer. Prior to that role, she held managerial roles in the County's Finance Department for 18 years.

officials.name: Bob Tyler
officials.address: 3200 Civic Center Circle NE Rio Rancho, NM 87144
officials.bio: Bob Tyler was elected as District 3 City Councilor in March 2018 and re-elected in 2022. He previously served as Deputy Mayor and is a retired law enforcement officer and U.S. Navy veteran.

officials.name: David Mann
officials.address: 3200 Civic Center Circle NE Rio Rancho, NM 87144
officials.bio: David Mann is proud to call Rio Rancho’s District 4 home. Born and raised in England, David grew up south of London. He is a dual citizen of the United States and the United Kingdom. His mother is from Kansas and his father is English. They met while attending university and settled in England to raise their family.

officials.name: Deborah Dapson
officials.address: 3200 Civic Center Circle NE Rio Rancho, NM 87144
officials.bio: Deborah Dapson and her husband have lived in Rio Rancho for 15 years. She is a mother to three grown children and grandmother to three. Councilor Dapson owns Copper Moon Media, a small business in Rio Rancho that specializes in graphic design and digital marketing.

officials.name: Jeremy Lenentine
officials.address: 3200 Civic Center Circle NE Rio Rancho, NM 87144
officials.bio: Deputy Mayor Lenentine has lived in Rio Rancho since 1988. All of his immediate family, including his wife and their three foster children, call Rio Rancho home and have been deeply tied to the community for a number of years. He has worked with Rio Rancho residents for about 10 years through his local church, organizing community events and helping residents with resources they need.

officials.name: Karissa Culbreath
officials.address: 3200 Civic Center Circle NE Rio Rancho, NM 87144

officials.name: Nicole List
officials.address: 3200 Civic Center Circle NE Rio Rancho, NM 87144

officials.name: Paul Wymer
officials.address: 3200 Civic Center Circle NE Rio Rancho, NM 87144
officials.bio: Paul Wymer, a licensed Architect and Certified Planner, has been a Rio Rancho resident since the early 1980s. He previously served on the City's Planning and Zoning Board and as a District 4 City Councilor before being elected Mayor in April 2026.

officials.name: Lisa Cacari Stone
officials.address: PO Box 276 Santa Fe, NM 87504-0276
officials.bio: I’m Lisa Cacari Stone, your Santa Fe County Commissioner for District 2. I am honored to serve our community with a leadership approach grounded in equity, transparency, and meaningful public engagement. My work is guided by two core principles: People Matter and Policy for All.

officials.name: Alma Castro
officials.address: 200 Lincoln Ave P.O. Box 909 Santa Fe, NM 87504
officials.bio: Alma G. Castro is a District One City Councilor, community organizer, and communications professional with more than a decade of experience advancing workers’ rights, economic justice, and community-led development. Born and raised in Santa Fe, Councilor Castro brings a background rooted in organizing, education, and entrepreneurship to her role in local government. As public servant, Castro is committed to transparent governance, equitable economic development, and policies that uplift working families.

officials.name: Patricia Feghali
officials.address: 200 Lincoln Ave P.O. Box 909 Santa Fe, NM 87504
officials.bio: Patricia "Pat" Feghali (pronounced "fig-alley") is a lawyer and urban planner with a long history of civic engagement and public service. Before being elected to City Council in District 1 in 2025 she spent four years working as an Assistant City Attorney for the City of Santa Fe. She began spending time in Santa Fe in the mid-1990s and moved here with her family in 2019.

officials.name: Elizabeth Barrett
officials.address:
200 Lincoln Ave
P.O. Box 909
Santa Fe, NM 87504
officials.bio: Elizabeth Barrett is a social worker and educator with over 20 years of public service experience, including work in schools, domestic violence prevention, and with veterans. She moved to New Mexico in 2003 and earned her Master's degree in social work in 2005. Liz is married with two children and is actively involved in the community as a soccer coach and Special Olympics program runner.

officials.name: Paul C. Bustamante
officials.address: 200 Lincoln Ave P.O. Box 909 Santa Fe, NM 87504
officials.bio: Paul Bustamante was born and raised in Albuquerque and comes from a family dedicated to public service. He served 8 years in the United States Air Force and has 24 years experience working for the federal government as a Systems Analyst and Security Analyst. Paul holds degrees from the Community College of the Air Force, University of New Mexico, and University of Southern Maine, and is a dedicated husband and father of three.

officials.name: Lee Garcia
officials.address:
200 Lincoln Ave
P.O. Box 909
Santa Fe, NM 87504
officials.bio: Lee A. Garcia is a 20-year resident of Santa Fe’s District 3, elected to the governing body on November 2, 2021, with a primary goal to provide strong leadership and unite people for District 3. A successful business owner, he has managed Garcia Tire LLC since 1999 and holds a master's degree in business administration. Councilor Garcia is a fervent advocate for community involvement, having served on the City of Santa Fe Planning Commission and as an active member of the Knights of Columbus.

officials.name: Pilar F.H. Faulkner
officials.address: 200 Lincoln Ave P.O. Box 909 Santa Fe, NM 87504
officials.bio: Pilar Faulkner brings more than 20 years of experience in government affairs, policy development, and complex negotiations to her role as City Councilor for District 3. A northern New Mexico native and Pojoaque High School graduate, she has dedicated her career to public service and delivering meaningful outcomes for the communities she serves. As City Councilor, Pilar works to advance thoughtful legislation, guide responsible budgeting, and engage residents on the issues that matter most to their neighborhoods.

officials.name: Amanda Chavez
officials.address:
200 Lincoln Ave
P.O. Box 909
Santa Fe, NM 87504
officials.bio: Councilor Chavez is a mother, educator, community servant, and mental health advocate. She was born and raised on the south side of Santa Fe by her parents, Eliseo and Tomasita Chavez, who are retired from the New Mexico state government. Councilor Chavez attended Sweeney Elementary School and, Turquoise Trail Elementary School, Capshaw Middle School and graduated from Santa Fe High School in 2003.

officials.name: Jamie Cassutt
officials.address:
200 Lincoln Ave
P.O. Box 909
Santa Fe, NM 87504
officials.bio: Jamie Cassutt was raised in Santa Fe and educated in Santa Fe’s public schools, graduating from Santa Fe High School in 2003. After spending over a decade on the West Coast for higher education and to gain experience in the public health field, she returned to Santa Fe to raise her son in her home community. As a public health professional, Jamie views all public policy as healthy policy and is committed to working for the welfare of all Santa Feans.

officials.name: Michael J. Garcia
officials.address:
200 Lincoln Ave
P.O. Box 909
Santa Fe, NM 87504
officials.bio: Mayor Michael J. Garcia was born and raised in Santa Fe, serving as City Councilor for District 2 before being elected Mayor. His public service career spans nearly two decades, focused on providing critical services to community members in need. He holds a bachelor's degree in political science and a master's degree in public administration from the University of New Mexico.

officials.name: Chad D. Chittum
officials.address:
2511 Camino Entrada
Santa Fe, NM 87507
officials.bio: The Honorable Chad D. Chittum was elected on November 7th, 2023, as the Presiding Judge of the Santa Fe Municipal Court. Prior to being elected, he served as the City of Santa Fe Municipal Court Prosecutor, Staff Attorney, and Pro-tem Judge. Judge Chittum received his Juris Doctor degree from St. Mary’s University and was admitted to the State Bar of New Mexico in 2012.
